info.title: LearnPuppy
info.description: Local LearnPuppy server API. Session cookie `lp_session` from the launch link; mutations need same Origin and `X-LP-CSRF: 1`.

get.summary: The account pool: status, cooldowns and usage. Never secrets.

post.summary: Adds another Claude profile directory (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) after checking its login.

422.description: No Claude login in that directory

post.summary: Re-runs account discovery into the live pool.

patch.summary: Excludes an account from the pool, or puts it back.

get.summary: One call at app start: version, device, workspaces, accounts, banners.
Server-sent events.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Also receive this workspace's events; without it only global events arrive.

get.summary: Liveness; needs no session (still Host-checked).

Searches every live workspace's propositions. A workspace slower than 300 ms is skipped and
named in `timedOut`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Hits to return in total; default 30, at most 100.

get.summary: Global settings: role profiles, pins, concurrency and UI preferences.

put.summary: Replaces the editable settings after validating them against the catalog and the pool.

get.summary: Providers, model ids, effort levels and the other choices settings forms offer.
Deleted workspaces waiting in the trash, newest first.

delete.summary: Deletes a trashed workspace for good.

post.summary: Restores a trashed workspace (renamed with a suffix if its name was taken).

get.summary: Workspaces with stats, most recently opened first; damaged directories are listed apart.
One workspace's metadata and stats.

delete.summary: Moves a workspace to the trash. The body must repeat its exact name.

patch.summary: Edits name, icon, hue, description, sources or overrides.

post.summary: Makes a workspace read-only and hides it from the default list.

get.summary: Chats, most recently updated first.
Everything the Classroom renders for one chat. A pending question never carries its answer.

delete.summary: Moves a chat to the workspace's `chats/.trash`.

get.summary: Decisions grouped by day, then coding session, newest first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Sessions started at or after this: epoch ms or `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Sessions started before this: epoch ms or `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC, start of that day).

get.summary: One decision with its session, linked cards and the git commits made while it ran.

post.summary:
Generates 4-choice cards for a decision. Drafts that fail the card-shape check come back in
`rejected`.

get.summary:
The whole graph, clusters and cached layout. `positions` is `null` and `layoutPending` true
while the layout is computed; `graph.changed` follows when it is ready.

ETag.description: Changes with the graph or its layout

get.summary: Chains touching the selected nodes, grouped by the conclusion's birth session.
One node with its provenance, chains, related nodes and linked cards.
Full-text search over propositions, best match first.

post.summary: Rewrites minimal metadata for a damaged workspace from its directory name.

get.summary: Browse every card, soonest due first.
One card with its answer, rationale and review history (the browser's drawer).
`[again, hard, good, easy]` intervals for a card.
Due cards at the server's `now`, oldest due first. Answers are withheld.
Review header numbers: due counts, streak, retention and a 14-day forecast.

ETag.description: Changes with the stats, not with the clock

post.summary: Merges other devices' review logs, then ships this device's cards.

Checks a choice without changing the schedule: correctness, the rationale, the suggested
grade and what each grade would schedule.
Grades a card (1 again .. 4 easy). A retry with the same `clientId` returns the first result.

AccountDto.description: One CLI account as the accounts screen shows it. Never carries tokens or credentials.

cooldownUntil.description: Epoch ms when a cooldown ends.

reauthHint.description: The command that renews an expired login.

requests.description: Requests in the current rate-limit window.

AccountSummaryDto.description: An account without credentials: provider, identity, health.

cooldownUntil.description: Epoch ms when a cooldown ends.

next.description: What the suggested grade would schedule.

latencyMs.description: How long the learner took, measured by the client.

Bootstrap.description: Everything the app needs at start, in one call.

dev.description: The server runs without a launch token (`serve --dev`).

CardBriefDto.description: A card as lists show it: scheduling, never the answer.

CardDetailDto.description: A card with everything, for the browser's detail drawer. Includes the answer.

CatalogDto.description: What the settings forms may offer.

pinRoles.description: Slots that take a pin, in display order.

ChainGroupDto.description: Chains touching the selection, grouped for the 3-level chain table.

sessionId.description: Birth session of the chain's conclusion.

seq.description: Counts from 1 per turn without gaps; a gap means the client must refetch.

jobs.description: Workbench jobs still running for this chat.

pending.description: A question waits for the learner.

ChoiceDto.description: An answer choice. `key` is `a`..`d` and is what `answer` takes.

ClassroomViewDto.description: Everything the Classroom renders, derived server-side from the stored session.

viewVersion.description: Changes with every saved turn; `chat.rest` carries the version to expect.

DamagedWorkspaceDto.description: A workspace directory whose `workspace.json` is missing or corrupt.

commits.description: Commits made while the session ran (allow-listed repos only).

commitsError.description: Why `commits` could not be read, when it could not.

folded.description: Already folded into the knowledge graph.

confirmName.description: The workspace's exact name (its id for a damaged one).

summary.description: One line: the first decision, plus how many more.

Empty.description: Payload-less events carry `{}` so `EventSource` still dispatches them.

EngineMode.description: Which LLM engine the server runs turns with.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error codes; the UI switches on these, never on messages.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Body of every non-2xx API response.

FieldError.description: One invalid input field; `path` is dotted (`profiles.teacher.model`, `items[2].id`).

clientId.description: Retries with the same id return the first result instead of grading twice.

from.description: The first premise; with `to` this is the drawn edge.

GraphDto.description: The whole graph, as one snapshot.

layoutPending.description: The layout is being computed; a `graph.changed` event follows when it is ready.

layoutVersion.description: The graph version the positions were computed for (equals `version` when present).

positions.description: Node id → `[x, y]`; `null` while the layout is computed.

version.description: Content hash; changes whenever a node or chain does. Same as `graph.changed.version`.

sessionId.description: The session or chat that first produced it.

answersCallId.description: For an answer: the question call it answers.

calls.description: Tool calls the assistant made in this message (names only, never arguments).

createdAt.description: Epoch ms; null for messages the transcript did not time-stamp.

cards.description: Cards generated from the decisions this node was distilled from.

NodeDetailDto.description: One node with everything the drawer shows.

key.description: What to send back as the answer.

profiles.description: Role → profile, replacing the global one in this workspace.

disabled.description: Exclude the account from the pool (or put it back).

PatchWorkspace.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

PendingDto.description: The question waiting for the learner. Has no field for the correct answer.

confidenceScale.description: Confidence slider `1..=n`; absent when the tool takes no confidence.

idkKey.description: The answer value that means "I don't know" (options only).

PreviewDto.description: What grading with one rating would schedule.

rungs.description: Hint rungs, when the mode has a ladder.

ProfileDto.description: Which CLI, model and reasoning effort a role runs on.

fallback.description: Let the account pool fall back to other providers.

messageIndex.description: Position in the chat transcript, when the message is still there.

QueueCardDto.description: A due card to answer. The correct option and rationale are withheld until `answer`.

kind.description: `decision` for cards made from an ingested decision, else `card`.

dueNow.description: Cards due now, beyond the page.

now.description: The server clock the queue was computed at (epoch ms).

added.description: Ids of accounts that were not in the pool before.

timedOut.description: Workspaces that did not answer in time; their hits are missing.

score.description: `0..=1`, higher is better; comparable across workspaces.

oneOf.description: Missed events are gone; refetch everything.

data.description: Missed events are gone; refetch everything.

SettingsDto.description: The global settings the UI edits.

profiles.description: Role → profile; roles without one are absent.

allow.description: Project directories whose sessions belong to this workspace; empty disables ingest.

forecast.description: Cards due per UTC day, starting `forecast_start`; day 0 includes overdue cards.

now.description: The server clock the stats were computed at (epoch ms).

retention30d.description: Share of recent reviews that were not `Again`, `0..=1`; null with no data.

bytes.description: Bytes the trashed workspace takes on disk.

VerdictDto.description: The grade of an answered quiz or probe. Exists only after the answer.

archived.description: Archived workspaces are read-only: mutations answer `409 workspace_archived`.

icon.description: A lucide icon name from the fixed allow-list.

id.description: `ws_` + 8 hex digits; routing always uses this.

tags.name: chats
tags.description: Learn chats and the Classroom view
